message: I remember the day my daughter called, a bit frazzled, saying they’d lost power during a storm. Thankfully, we had a small emergency kit ready to go. It made such a difference to know I could help her with flashlights, snacks, and a few comforting items to keep the kids entertained. Having a few essentials on hand really can feel like a small win in uncertain moments. What little things do you keep close that bring you peace?
